summary: Brother of John's grandfather James C. Meier (John's great-uncle).
bio: Son of William F. Meier and Florence L. Pringle; 'William, son, about 3' in the 1930 Wilkes-Barre census (55 Cedar St) and 'William Jr., son, 23' in the 1950 census (house 55, ED 40-102). Nothing further recorded.
sources: 1930 census Wilkes-Barre ED 40-261 sheet 23B; 1950 census ED 40-102 sheet 2 (FamilySearch GF3P-853 images)
